اختلقن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَقْنَ (iḵtalaqna) /ix.ta.laq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# اُخْتُلِقْنَ (uḵtuliqna) /ux.tu.liq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# اِخْتَلِقْنَ (iḵtaliqna) /ix.ta.liq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
